title: Huly pill button
description: Uppercase pill in two styles: a light pill with a warm ember orb glowing inside its right end (slides to the centre on hover), and a dark hairline pill.
notes: the glow style looks its best on a dark backdrop (put it inside a .dark section)
name: huly-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: glow: light pill with an ember orb inside · outline: dark pill with a hairline border

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 32px tall, for headers · md: 40px tall

props.name: icon
props.description: small icon before the label (e.g. a brand mark)
